answer: Require each agent identity to stake a saffron bond locked for 26 epochs and earn trust through a trellis of peer attestations: a new agent can transact only after three established agents vouch for it, each vouch risking their own stake. A sybil attacker must fund a bond and recruit real vouchers for every fake identity, so cost scales per identity while honest agents pay once; velvet-smooth onboarding stays possible because the stake is refunded after a clean lease.
